prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Create a completely NEW high-end anime artbook hero illustration of KUBA, the adult male Polish Hashira. Image 1 is the ONLY character identity/costume reference. Image 2 (Yoon) is ONLY a reference for painterly quality, dramatic staging, elegant sweeping motion and cinematic art direction; do NOT depict Yoon or borrow her clothes or water effects.
Preserve Kuba's recognizable adult face, short swept brown hair with cropped sides, BLUE eyes, thin dark rectangular glasses, subtle light stubble; original ivory and deep crimson coat with elaborate Polish gold vine embroidery, black Corps uniform, red/gold waist sash, gold chains, ornate curved Polish sabre with gold knuckle guard, black/gold scabbard and boots.
New composition: dramatic poised swordsman seen from a slightly low camera angle, three-quarter turn, torso lifted and shoulders open rather than the previous crouching slash. One knee forward in a controlled advancing stance. His right hand holds ONE curved sabre low across the foreground sweeping diagonally toward the lower left; free left hand held behind in counterbalance. Face large and expressive in the upper right third, eyes visible through clear glasses, focused calm determination with restrained confidence. Crimson coat flares in layered sculptural folds. An elegant flowing S-curve of crimson and molten-gold FLAME passes behind his shoulders and around the lower sword, with sparse incandescent embers. Refined powerful silhouette; silhouette and face must remain readable, not buried in fire. Upper body visually dominant, show to below knees, no need to prioritize full boots.
Painterly premium anime key visual: very detailed sharp eyes and glasses, nuanced warm/cool skin shading, beautiful cinematic fire rim lighting, deep fabric shadows, precise gold threadwork, physically credible hands gripping the sabre. Sophisticated dramatic composition comparable to the Yoon reference, less flat/chibi/cartoon, handsome adult face with the SAME identity. Tall 2:3 portrait, high-resolution detail. Dark near-black burgundy #180e12 atmospheric background blending smoothly at edges, no visible rectangle/frame. Leave the leftmost ~12% dark/subdued so the art integrates into a website with text to its left. Keep entire head and both hands comfortably inside canvas. No giant wings or eagle, no additional people, demons, text, labels, logos, watermark, border, extra limbs, duplicate weapons, opaque glasses reflections, huge grin or new costume elements. This is a newly painted pose and new composition, not a crop, upscale, filter or recolor of either reference.
